title: Set up RESORIXtrack
sub: A few details about your company. Everything can be changed later under Administration → Settings.
timezone_help: Default for new employees; each person can change their own.
rules_sub: Defaults for new employees. You can set a different schedule per person.
vacation_days_help: Proposed when you add an employee.
holidays_help: Applied to all employees by default. More calendars can be added later.
no_holidays: Skip – set up public holidays later
admin_sub: You will use it to create teams and invite employees, and to record your own working time.
employment_start_help: Target hours and vacation are counted from this day.
code_help: Printed in the server log when RESORIXtrack starts (docker compose logs app) or shown by `flask resorixtrack setup-code`.
no_smtp: No email server is configured yet. Invitations and password resets will not be sent until SMTP_HOST is set in the .env file; you can set passwords for employees manually in the meantime.
